item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: I'd like some help with how I come across in this pic. I've been feeling a little unsure about whether it gives the right impression. What I'm hoping you can do is make me, the man in the photo, look professional. I always find it surprisingly hard to judge my own photos.
turns.agent:
Your direct eye contact and straightforward expression already give the photo a confident feel. The T-shirt and kitchen background make it read more casual than professional—not anything about your face.

I tried to create a version with a navy blazer, light blue shirt, soft lighting, and a neutral background, while preserving your natural appearance. **Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits**, so no edited image was created.

For a no-cost retake, try a plain wall, a collared shirt, and soft window light. Position the camera at eye level and relax your expression into a slight smile for a professional but approachable impression.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Turn this man's supplied portrait into a realistic professional headshot. Preserve his exact recognizable facial identity, age, facial structure, short gray hair, natural stubble, eye color and natural skin texture. Keep the same direct gaze and head-and-shoulders composition, with a subtly relaxed approachable expression. Replace the gray T-shirt with a well-tailored navy blazer over a crisp light blue open-collar shirt, no tie. Replace the kitchen entirely with a simple softly blurred neutral gray studio background. Use soft flattering professional portrait lighting, balanced natural skin tones and sharp eyes. Authentic photographic result, restrained retouching, no age reduction, no plastic skin, no text or logos.
